commits: Intake: 3D-142 distance tool in the 3D view (proposed, mirror shared); Q-50..Q-53 open
finalText:
The request is now in the backlog as a proposed row; nothing was built, because the project rules route every new request through intake first and you weren't available to answer the scoping questions.

- **Class:** `external` — the tool is client-side work in `shared_compnents` (`workspace/tools`), not in this repository. It isn't in spec v0.3 §6, isn't on the excluded list, and no existing row covered it.
- **Row:** 3D-142 "Distance tool in the 3D view", status `proposed`, size S, depends on 3D-42 (the 3DQM tools row, which provides picking and snapping). Estimate $3.00 (p80 $4.13). Committed locally as `2632713`, not pushed; the docs check passes.
- **What you need to do:** answer Q-50..Q-53 in `docs/decisions/DECISIONS.md`, then set 3D-142 `ready`.

The four open questions, with the reading I wrote into the row as the proposal for each:

| Question | Proposed | Alternatives |
|---|---|---|
| Q-50: what can be picked | Model vertices, edges, faces and point-cloud points | Model only; or also a free point in space |
| Q-51: what is shown | 3D distance, horizontal distance and height difference, in metres | 3D distance only; or add slope angle |
| Q-52: lifetime of a measurement | Transient, never saved, no kernel command | Several kept for the session; or saved with the building |
| Q-53: release | First release, built after 3D-42 | P1; or also required by the geoviewer POC (3D-140) |

Q-52 matters most for size: saving measurements with the building would need a contract s
